senses.gloss: --the divine union of शक्त and शक्ति resulting in २५ truths. Br. IV. 8. २९, ३३.
(III)--the capital of the नागस् of whom seven are distinguished. वा. ९९. ३८३.
--in the neck of the personified Veda. वा. १०४. ८०.
--a tribe; ended their lives by killing their own men. भा. X. 1. २७; XI. ३०. १८.
--one of the seven sons of Vidyoparicara. a Vasu and Girika. वा. ९९. २२२. [page२-681+ २७]
